reason: Information item, 0 runtime, no score gain claimed, and its facts hold up. I recomputed them from the 16:52 UTC CLI CSV (3,904 teams). Blocks: 0.954 = ranks 130-192, 0.953 = 193-448 (256 teams). We are #149. Kunal Desale's verbatim x138 is #228. Ranks 195 and 390 are both 0.953. Tie order: 34 of the 43 teams below us in the 0.954 block submitted before our #35, and only 2 of the 19 above us submitted later. Inversion fraction of submission date against rank: 0.59 for ranks 193-227 (random, so these are unrounded variants) and 0.25 for ranks 228-448 (mostly time-sorted, so these are tied byte-copies). Two parts of its framing fail the private-transfer lens and must be corrected. (1) The public rank-195 score is not the private silver line. On private, the byte-copies stay tied at X (x138's private score) and the variant teams reshuffle, because public/private noise is larger than the 0.001 blocks. Falling below X costs the medal, not only silver: rank would be at least (teams above X) + ~220 copies, about 450, which is past bronze at 390. The number of teams at 0.954 or higher grew 92 -> 192 in 30 h. If more than ~390 teams end up above X, a result only just above X is not even bronze, so the real watch metric is that count. (2) 'Sub-0.001 value of C01 and lowrefine' is overstated. C01 changes nothing unless the timer fires; it is tail insurance. The lowrefine ceiling from the metric: it touches ~1.3k readmitted nodes of ~122k (~1%), so even 5% of them becoming matched is about +0.0003 edge Jaccard (guess), plus 0 on the 0.1 x division term. That is about 10-30 places among the variant teams. Our rank inside a public block reads sub-0.001 public differences on the public subset. That is exactly the overfit channel R7/R9 forbid for choices, so it must stay status-only.
fix: Adopt as status/monitoring only. (a) Status line: our public rank, the 0.953/0.954 block edges, count(public >= 0.954), and the final team count x 5% / 10%. Recompute the thresholds at the end, not from 3,904. (b) State in §f that the private cliff is X = medal versus no medal, so the objective is P(private > X) first and silver second. This matches lens_private-finals. (c) Never use within-block rank or position moves after a submission to choose between near-copies. R3/R4/R7 stay as registered. (d) Keep the 27 Sep ~09:00 UTC CLI LB diff plus the Code-tab scan, before R8. Trigger: a new public notebook above 0.953 with a copy wave, which moves X upward. If one appears, only its mechanism may enter through the R8 path, not its score. (e) Do not call C01 a sub-0.001 rider.
